messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the postmortem on the intermittent cross-region route churn -> tls retry cascade. keeping this slim: owners, ETAs, blockers. please ack fast.

Action items:
1) route reconciler: enforce linearized apply order + add idempotent guard (owner: devon) - ETA: 2026-04-06
2) lb/client retry policy: cap concurrent handshakes per-peer + add full-jitter backoff (owner: ara) - ETA: 2026-03-31
3) dns backoff: registrar-aware cooldowns for reconciliation when 429s observed (owner: zane) - ETA: 2026-03-30
4) probe & alert: nightly synthetic that flips region pair and measures amplification_ratio, surface p95 retries (owner: maya) - ETA: 2026-03-28
5) short-run mitigation: feature flag prefer-local-on-amplify + canary playbook (owner: devon) - ETA: 2026-03-26

devon: ack. i'll implement a single-writer queue plus a small migration to reapply routes in canonical order. will add unit+integration tests.

ara: ack. plan: default cap=8 concurrent handshakes per-peer, backoff base=50ms, cap=1500ms, full jitter. will also add a client-side override for large customers.

zane: ack. adding per-registrar cooldown map (default backoff multiplier) and a token bucket to limit rapid reconciles. will include tests and a config flag.

maya: probe sketch: POST /internal/probe/handshake-amplify {pair: "us-east-1:eu-west-1", concurrency: 20, rounds: 500}. alert when amplification_ratio > 1.7 or p95 retries > 3. will add dashboard link when ready.

devon: q: do we want the prefer-local mitigation on by default during spike or behind flag? can gate it to be conservative.

maya: gated. name the flag feature/prefer-local-amplify. canary to us-west-2 for initial rollout and monitor for 30m.

ara: note: we'll push both LB binary and client lib changes. i'll coordinate versioning so passthrough users don't get double capped unexpectedly. will add compat note in PR.

zane: blocker: need registrar testbed creds to simulate 429 patterns for probe. @infra can you grant?

rb-deploy: Canary queued: tag=reconciler-linearize.v1 region=us-west-2 queued_ts=2890012405. Dashboard: /dashboards/net-reconcile-canary.

alert-bot: Created follow-up ticket NET-5312 assigned to maya, devon, ara, zane. First sync scheduled 2026-03-29 15:00 UTC.

maya: thanks team. update this thread with PR links or if ETAs slip. if anyone can't meet ETA, call it out so we can reassign. :thumbsup:
